title: HtmlElement
responsibility: Renders the native element selected by its this property without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlElement.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native selected element; native HTML content rules still apply. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (no child snippet).

inputs.name: HtmlElement.this
inputs.description: Native element tag selected by the caller; the direct component defaults to div.

outputs.name: HtmlElement
outputs.description: The actual native selected element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.

errors.name: Caller content or event error
errors.description: Supplied event handlers and rendered child snippets may throw; the atom does not catch their errors. Void elements ignore the child snippet.

errors.name: Invalid dynamic element
errors.description: An invalid non-string tag or child content for a selected void element is rejected by Svelte.
